effects._r2_note: trait_r2, trait_strong_r2 and disease_r2 are the variance explained by one causal variant; for effects through expression the expression-to-trait edge is scaled to hit that target

scenarios.name: mediated
scenarios.about: variant A changes a CpG, the CpG changes expression, expression changes the trait

scenarios.name: two_signals
scenarios.about: two independent eQTL variants A and B; the trait follows expression

scenarios.name: linkage
scenarios.about: eQTL at A, trait at a different variant B in moderate LD with A

scenarios.name: pleiotropy
scenarios.about: A acts on expression and on the trait through separate paths

scenarios.name: gwas_only
scenarios.about: A acts on the trait directly; the teaching gene has no eQTL

scenarios.name: eqtl_only
scenarios.about: eQTL at A; no effect on any trait

scenarios.name: gwas_two
scenarios.about: two trait variants A and B; only A is also an eQTL

scenarios.name: binary
scenarios.about: A changes expression, expression changes disease risk

scenarios.name: ancestry
scenarios.about: eQTL variant A is common in YRI and rare in EUR; the trait follows expression

scenarios.name: capstone
scenarios.about: held out: CpG-mediated eQTL at A, a second eQTL at B, and a direct trait variant C
